spans.s:
(-नी)
 A gloss, a comment; sometimes used in the sense of ‘a gloss on a gloss’
; as Kaiyaṭaʼs commentary on the Mahābhāṣya, or Nāgojībhaṭṭaʼs
 gloss on Kaiyaṭaʼs gloss.
